posts.author: Robro33
posts.body: whatever the icon.png file is inside your project's icon folder is your game's icon

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
@Robro33
But not for the .exe file icon, at least I don't believe so.

posts.author: MAH1RO
posts.body:
-place the .png/.ico -file somewhere in the game folder
-right-click the eye --> properties
-there you can set up a new icon for the .exe-file
At least, this is the standard way to change any icon. Maybe here are other ways too, I don't know.
But if you do it this way, check if it still works if you copy the game folder to another location, or when you copy it to an USB and test it on another computer.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
MAH1RO said:
At least, this is the standard way to change any icon.
Click to expand...
Windows does not provide a way for you to just change the icons of executables.
What you described is for changing the icon of a shortcut you made; there are other ways you can change the icons of different file types. But icons for executables are internally defined.
The tools
@BK-tdm
mentioned can do what's being asked (I actually wasn't aware the Cook Tool offered that functionality, but for sure Resource Hacker).
